info.name: WLMS Phase 2 API Tests
info.description: 22 solicitudes automatizadas con aserciones de estado, esquema JSON y contenido. Incluye un flujo de negocio encadenado de ventas: login -> usuario -> cliente -> crear orden de venta -> avanzar a Processing -> verificar -> cancelar -> verificar Cancelled -> rechazar avance y segunda cancelación. La orden no lleva líneas, por lo que no reserva ni altera inventario.

exec: pm.test('Item schema is valid when present', () => { if (body.length) { pm.expect(body[0]).to.include.keys('item_id','item_name','reorder_level','uom_symbol','is_active'); } });

pm.test('New SO starts Pending and Unpaid', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('Pending'); pm.expect(body.payment_status).to.eql('Unpaid'); });

item.name: 17 - Flow: advance sales order to Processing

exec: pm.test('Advance is confirmed for this SO', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('soId'))));

pm.test('SO detail matches JSON schema', () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type": "object", "required": ["so_id", "customer_name", "created_by", "status", "payment_status", "lines"], "properties": {"so_id": {"type": "integer"}, "customer_name": {"type": "string"}, "created_by": {"type": "string"}, "status": {"type": "string"}, "payment_status": {"type": "string"}, "lines": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["item_name", "ordered_quantity", "shipped_quantity", "pending_quantity", "unit_price", "line_total", "uom_symbol"], "properties": {"item_name": {"type": "string"}, "ordered_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "shipped_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "pending_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "unit_price": {"type": "number"}, "line_total": {"type": "number"}, "uom_symbol": {"type": "string"}}}}}}));

pm.test('Cancellation releases reservations', () => { const m = pm.response.json().message; pm.expect(m).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('soId'))); pm.expect(m).to.include('Reserved stock released'); });

pm.test('SO detail matches JSON schema', () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type": "object", "required": ["so_id", "customer_name", "created_by", "status", "payment_status", "lines"], "properties": {"so_id": {"type": "integer"}, "customer_name": {"type": "string"}, "created_by": {"type": "string"}, "status": {"type": "string"}, "payment_status": {"type": "string"}, "lines": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["item_name", "ordered_quantity", "shipped_quantity", "pending_quantity", "unit_price", "line_total", "uom_symbol"], "properties": {"item_name": {"type": "string"}, "ordered_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "shipped_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "pending_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "unit_price": {"type": "number"}, "line_total": {"type": "number"}, "uom_symbol": {"type": "string"}}}}}}));
